text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them highly organised. To retrieve information, you use queries written in structured query language. Good data modelling helps you design tables that reflect real-world relationships and reduce duplication. Indexes are also important because they speed up searches, especially when tables contain large amounts of data. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, offer more flexibility for unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
